title: X-15 Documentary
description: X-15 Documentary focused on the X-15 as a near-space vehicle. Early test footage, engineers in mission control room, in-flight footage from B-52 and chase aircraft, on-board the X-15, accidents, audio, maintenance, and pilots.
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
